label: Allied Telesis AT-x530-52GTXm
description: Allied Telesis AT-x530-52GTXm stackable L3 access switch: 40x 10/100/1000T RJ-45, 8x 100M/1G/2.5G/5G RJ-45, 4x 1/10G SFP+ uplinks, no PoE, 240 Gbps switching fabric, 179 Mpps.

fabric.note: Vendor switching-fabric figure (forwarding rate 179 Mpps), the full-duplex aggregate of the port rates: 2 x (120000 Mbit/s of line rate).

notes: The unpowered 52-port twin of the 52GPXm. Port numbering: copper 1-40, multi-gigabit 41-48, SFP+ 49-52, with 51/S1 and 52/S2 the default stacking ports. 441 x 323 x 44 mm, 5.3 kg, 85 W, 42 dBA - half the depth of the PoE model because there is no PoE supply to fit. Takes the AT-BRKT-J22 wall-mount kit. Console is the front-panel RJ-45 RS-232 port (AlliedWare Plus default 9600 8-N-1, no flow control; the switch ships with the manager/friend logins), reached with the RJ-45-to-DB-9 cable in the box or an AT-VT-Kit3 USB-to-serial cable. The management panel also carries a USB port and the eco-friendly button; neither is a network interface, so neither is modelled. Numbers: the x530 Series datasheet SPECIFICATIONS and Power and Noise tables and the model page at https://www.alliedtelesis.com/us/en/products/switches/x530-series; port numbering from the x530 Quick Installation Guide (https://www.alliedtelesis.com/sites/default/files/file/2022-03/ati-x530-english-qig.pdf) and, for the 10/18/28GSX/DP port fronts, the VCStack installation guide (https://www.alliedtelesis.com/sites/default/files/documents/installation-guides/ati_x530_vc_stacking_ig.pdf).
